Bro, **that message promises credential collection before it actually starts.** It’s [hardcoded into the handoff](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/service.py:298).

I checked this exact run:

1. Clanker opened that private thread.
2. Its browser hit Swiggy’s “We’ll be back shortly” page before reaching login.
3. It sent the failure [back to the original channel](https://clanker-global.slack.com/archives/C0C6J277ZNG/p1791410759656149) and marked the worker completed, leaving the DM hanging.

The bug is misleading handoff wording plus no closing update in the private thread. **No credential form was created, so it wasn’t waiting for anything from you.**
Make the private thread show the real outcome: only promise a credential form once it exists, and post a closing update there when the task stops. I’ll implement and check that locally.
